criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.

evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Identify H1 targeted-versus-control and untargeted-control contrasts, significance/selection rules, gene units, duplicate identifiers, and whether only significant results are tabulated. H9 is a different biological context.

Targeted Pansio-1 H1 clones show 96 significant DE genes versus 260 in the independent untargeted H1 control — fewer, not more, significant changes than the control contrast — but 31/96 (32.3%) of targeted DE genes are also significant in the untargeted control, all in the same direction, so a substantial fraction of the targeted signal is not distinguishable from untargeted-culture variation. No mapped DE gene overlaps the candidate interval; the nearest mapped DE gene is 4,352,716 bp away (nearest_reference_base_distance_bp). However, the required exclusion criteria are not all computable: candidate-to-GENCODE gene-body/TSS/miRNA/lncRNA distances were not produced by the proximity tool (it measured DE-gene distances, not candidate-to-annotation distances), and cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region sources are unavailable. Aggregate evidence is therefore incomplete, and no global safe/excluded label can be assigned. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality.

calculation.source_table_coordinate_conversion: Ensembl one-based closed gene spans: start minus one, end unchanged; kept separate from GENCODE v36.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

limitations: Unmapped and noncanonical source identifiers remain visible and may limit proximity claims.
Distance from DE genes cannot establish or exclude cis regulation, causality or biological safety.
CASP9 is included in the targeting construct; RNA-seq counts do not distinguish construct from endogenous transcription.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Synthesize the available numerical results and methods. Use tools to resolve missing consequential evidence. Explain what the expression comparison supports or questions, with exact counts and denominators. Control variation can contextualize a concern but does not establish causality or safety. Preserve uncertainty when required evidence is missing. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

{"conclusion": "The measured expression changes do not justify excluding the Pansio-1 candidate region. In H1 human embryonic stem cells, the targeted Pansio-1 clone versus reference untargeted H1 contrast yields 96 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (48 up, 48 down) at |log2FC|>=1 and FDR<=0.01, while the independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control yields 260 DE genes. proposal.conclusion: The measured expression changes do not justify excluding the Pansio-1 candidate region. In H1 human embryonic stem cells, the targeted Pansio-1 clone versus reference untargeted H1 contrast yields 96 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (48 up, 48 down) at |log2FC|>=1 and FDR<=0.01, while the independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control yields 260 DE genes. The two significant-only sets share 31 genes (overlap fraction 31/96 = 0.3229), leaving 65 targeted-only genes; all 31 shared genes agree in direction. This substantial independent-untargeted variation contextualizes the targeted changes but does not establish that the targeted changes are caused by the edit, nor does it establish safety. Genomic context is permissive on the criteria that could be computed: zero GENCODE v36 gene-body overlaps, nearest gene-body interval gap 50000 bp (MAGI3), nearest TSS reference-base distance 50001 bp, nearest miRNA 878128 bp, nearest lncRNA 266848 bp. However, three required criteria (cancer-gene distance, DHS buffer, ultraconserved regions) are unavailable, so the screen is incomplete and no aggregate pass/fail can be issued. Of the 96 targeted DE genes, 90 mapped to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes; the nearest mapped DE gene is 4352715 bp away (interval gap), and 6 DE IDs on noncanonical/patch contigs remain unmapped. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, so exclusion is not justified by available evidence.

DHS hypersensitivity buffer (ENCFF503GCK +/- 2 kb) is not ingested; overlap_count cannot be evaluated.
Versioned GRCh38 ultraconserved regions and the original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced; overlap_count cannot be evaluated.
No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold defines exclusion, so the 96 targeted DE genes and 31/96 control overlap cannot be converted into an exclusion decision.
Six targeted DE IDs map to noncanonical/patch contigs and remain unmapped, so proximity claims cover only the 90 GENCODE-mapped DE genes.
The significant-only tables omit nonsignificant rows and the full measured-gene denominator, so absence of effect for unlisted genes cannot be inferred.
Whether the 65 targeted-only DE genes reflect the edit, clonal background or culture variation is unresolved; the independent untargeted contrast shows 260 DE genes and cannot separate these causes.
qPCR means for MAGI3 (0.0531), TXNL1 (-0.0462) and ZNRF4 (-0.0121) log2FC are near zero but carry no frozen exclusion threshold and no significance claim here.

The targeted Pansio-1 H1 contrast yields 96 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (48 up, 48 down) at |log2FC|>=1 and FDR<=0.01, while the independent untargeted H1 contrast yields 260; 31 genes are shared and 65 are targeted-only, giving a shared/targeted overlap fraction of 0.3229166666666667 (Jaccard 0.09538461538461539, all 31 shared in the same direction). GENCODE v36 screening passes outside_gene_body (overlap_count 0), tss_distance (nearest reference base distance 50001 bp > 50000, interval gap 50000 bp to MAGI3/ENST00000307546.14), mirna_distance (878128 bp) and lncrna_distance (266848 bp), but the aggregate screen is incomplete because cancer_gene_distance, outside_dhs_buffer and outside_ultraconserved_regions are unavailable. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, so exclusion_decision is not_justified_by_available_evidence and evidence_status is unknown. The tss_distance pass is marginal (50001 vs 50000) and rests on a new GENCODE v36 analysis, not the publication's Ensembl release 103 / GENCODE v35 pipeline. GENCODE-mapped DE gene counts and nearest mapped DE gene gap were not obtained within the tool budget and remain null, not zero. The qPCR endpoint means (MAGI3 0.0530824649813724, TXNL1 -0.04620831724507905, ZNRF4 -0.012078959496150479) are near zero but carry no exclusion threshold and cannot be read as safety.
unresolved_questions: What are the GENCODE v36-mapped DE gene count and the nearest mapped DE gene gap for the 96 targeted and 260 control DE genes? These artifacts were not consumed within the tool budget, so mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp remain null.

Do the 31 shared DE genes reflect shared culture/background variation rather than candidate-region effects? The control contrast shows 260 independent untargeted DE genes, but no frozen threshold converts this into an exclusion decision.

Would cancer_gene_distance, outside_dhs_buffer and outside_ultraconserved_regions pass or fail if COSMIC v92, ENCFF503GCK and a versioned GRCh38 ultraconserved track were ingested? All three are unavailable, so the aggregate screen cannot be completed.
Does the marginal tss_distance result (50001 bp vs a 50000 bp threshold) survive the publication's original Ensembl release 103 / GENCODE v35 annotation rather than the new GENCODE v36 analysis?
Which qPCR gene set is authoritative: the criteria endpoint lists MAGI3, TXNL1 and ZNRF4, while the inspect artifact lists MAGI3 and TXNL1; the qPCR computation reports means for all three.
Are the near-zero qPCR means for MAGI3, TXNL1 and ZNRF4 reproducible across independent H1 cultures, and what endpoint would they be compared against given exclusion_threshold is null?
proposal.limitations: Significant-only tables: the 96 targeted and 260 control DE counts come from significant-only DEseq2 tables, so no inference of zero expression or absence of biological effects is possible from omitted rows, and no all-measured-genes denominator exists. Reference not personal H1: GRCh38 is a reference assembly, not a personalized H1 genome, so coordinates and distances are reference-based. Control overlap is not causality: 31 shared genes (fraction 0.3229166666666667) and 65 targeted-only genes contextualize the targeted changes but cannot establish that the candidate region caused them or that overlap implies safety. Distance is not safety: the 50000 bp gene-body interval gap and 50001 bp nearest-reference-base TSS distance are proximity measurements only; the tss_distance pass is marginal and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Missing cancer/regulatory evidence: cancer_gene_distance, outside_dhs_buffer and outside_ultraconserved_regions are unavailable, so the aggregate screen is incomplete and no global safe label is assigned. Unmapped DE IDs: GENCODE-mapped DE gene counts and nearest mapped DE gene gap were not computed within the tool budget and are reported as null, not zero. Source count discrepancy: the criteria endpoint lists three qPCR genes (MAGI3, TXNL1, ZNRF4) while the inspect artifact lists two (MAGI3, TXNL1); the qPCR computation reports three, and this is unreconciled. Controls were available (260 independent untargeted DE genes), so controls_unavailable is not asserted. H9 context was not consumed, so cell_context_not_transferable is not asserted. Overall suitability is not established.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Independently challenge numerical claims, denominators, control awareness, applicability to H1, and unsupported biological conclusions. Reconcile contradictions explicitly. Do not turn absent results into failures or label suitability established. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Publish a concise inspectable synthesis scoped to the named endpoint and assay. Include evidence IDs and remaining limitations. Label publication-derived shortlist, deterministic operational versus real model mode, and provisional unknowns faithfully. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

criteria.aggregate_rule: Missing any required evidence means incomplete. Otherwise any failed criterion means fail, and all passed means pass. Individual failures remain visible while aggregate evidence is incomplete.

criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.
Minimum distance to any annotated transcription start site exceeds 50 kb. TSS is txStart on plus strand, txEnd-1 on minus strand; gene-body distance is a separate measurement.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated miRNA gene exceeds 300 kb.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated lncRNA gene exceeds 100 kb.
Original study used COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census. Licensing and exact source unresolved; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.
Outside DNase hypersensitivity clusters plus or minus 2 kb; track not ingested.
Ultraconserved region source and original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control
experimental_endpoints.table_coverage: Significant-only results; no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows.
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Reconciliation must state limitations and unresolved questions.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted and independent untargeted H1 cultures versus reference untargeted H1
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: Numerical replicate values are provided; significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

raw_model_proposal.conclusion: The measured expression changes do not justify excluding the Pansio-1 candidate region. In H1 human embryonic stem cells, the targeted Pansio-1 clone versus reference untargeted H1 contrast yields 96 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (48 up, 48 down) at |log2FC|>=1 and FDR<=0.01, while the independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control yields 260 DE genes. The two significant-only sets share 31 genes (overlap fraction 31/96 = 0.3229), leaving 65 targeted-only genes; all 31 shared genes agree in direction. This substantial independent-untargeted variation contextualizes the targeted changes but does not establish that the targeted changes are caused by the edit, nor does it establish safety. Genomic context is permissive on the criteria that could be computed: zero GENCODE v36 gene-body overlaps, nearest gene-body interval gap 50000 bp (MAGI3), nearest TSS reference-base distance 50001 bp, nearest miRNA 878128 bp, nearest lncRNA 266848 bp. However, three required criteria (cancer-gene distance, DHS buffer, ultraconserved regions) are unavailable, so the screen is incomplete and no aggregate pass/fail can be issued. Of the 96 targeted DE genes, 90 mapped to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes; the nearest mapped DE gene is 4352715 bp away (interval gap), and 6 DE IDs on noncanonical/patch contigs remain unmapped. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, so exclusion is not justified by available evidence.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Synthesize the available numerical results and methods. Use tools to resolve missing consequential evidence. Explain what the expression comparison supports or questions, with exact counts and denominators. Control variation can contextualize a concern but does not establish causality or safety. Preserve uncertainty when required evidence is missing. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

proposal.conclusion: The measured expression changes do not justify excluding the Pansio-1 candidate region. In H1 human embryonic stem cells, the targeted Pansio-1 clone versus reference untargeted H1 contrast yields 96 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (48 up, 48 down) at |log2FC|>=1 and FDR<=0.01, while the independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control yields 260 DE genes. The two significant-only sets share 31 genes (overlap fraction 31/96 = 0.3229), leaving 65 targeted-only genes; all 31 shared genes agree in direction. This substantial independent-untargeted variation contextualizes the targeted changes but does not establish that the targeted changes are caused by the edit, nor does it establish safety. Genomic context is permissive on the criteria that could be computed: zero GENCODE v36 gene-body overlaps, nearest gene-body interval gap 50000 bp (MAGI3), nearest TSS reference-base distance 50001 bp, nearest miRNA 878128 bp, nearest lncRNA 266848 bp. However, three required criteria (cancer-gene distance, DHS buffer, ultraconserved regions) are unavailable, so the screen is incomplete and no aggregate pass/fail can be issued. Of the 96 targeted DE genes, 90 mapped to GENCODE v36 canonical chromosomes; the nearest mapped DE gene is 4352715 bp away (interval gap), and 6 DE IDs on noncanonical/patch contigs remain unmapped. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, so exclusion is not justified by available evidence.

Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Independently challenge numerical claims, denominators, control awareness, applicability to H1, and unsupported biological conclusions. Reconcile contradictions explicitly. Do not turn absent results into failures or label suitability established. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools.

proposal.conclusion: The candidate assessment's numerical findings are only partially supported by the consumed evidence, and exclusion is not justified. The targeted Pansio-1 H1 contrast yields 96 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (48 up, 48 down) at |log2FC|>=1 and FDR<=0.01, while the independent untargeted H1 contrast yields 260; 31 genes are shared and 65 are targeted-only, giving a shared/targeted overlap fraction of 0.3229166666666667 (Jaccard 0.09538461538461539, all 31 shared in the same direction). GENCODE v36 screening passes outside_gene_body (overlap_count 0), tss_distance (nearest reference base distance 50001 bp > 50000, interval gap 50000 bp to MAGI3/ENST00000307546.14), mirna_distance (878128 bp) and lncrna_distance (266848 bp), but the aggregate screen is incomplete because cancer_gene_distance, outside_dhs_buffer and outside_ultraconserved_regions are unavailable. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety, so exclusion_decision is not_justified_by_available_evidence and evidence_status is unknown. The tss_distance pass is marginal (50001 vs 50000) and rests on a new GENCODE v36 analysis, not the publication's Ensembl release 103 / GENCODE v35 pipeline. GENCODE-mapped DE gene counts and nearest mapped DE gene gap were not obtained within the tool budget and remain null, not zero. The qPCR endpoint means (MAGI3 0.0530824649813724, TXNL1 -0.04620831724507905, ZNRF4 -0.012078959496150479) are near zero but carry no exclusion threshold and cannot be read as safety.
unresolved_questions: What are the GENCODE v36-mapped DE gene count and the nearest mapped DE gene gap for the 96 targeted and 260 control DE genes? These artifacts were not consumed within the tool budget, so mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp remain null.

Do the 31 shared DE genes reflect shared culture/background variation rather than candidate-region effects? The control contrast shows 260 independent untargeted DE genes, but no frozen threshold converts this into an exclusion decision.

Would cancer_gene_distance, outside_dhs_buffer and outside_ultraconserved_regions pass or fail if COSMIC v92, ENCFF503GCK and a versioned GRCh38 ultraconserved track were ingested? All three are unavailable, so the aggregate screen cannot be completed.
Does the marginal tss_distance result (50001 bp vs a 50000 bp threshold) survive the publication's original Ensembl release 103 / GENCODE v35 annotation rather than the new GENCODE v36 analysis?
Which qPCR gene set is authoritative: the criteria endpoint lists MAGI3, TXNL1 and ZNRF4, while the inspect artifact lists MAGI3 and TXNL1; the qPCR computation reports means for all three.
Are the near-zero qPCR means for MAGI3, TXNL1 and ZNRF4 reproducible across independent H1 cultures, and what endpoint would they be compared against given exclusion_threshold is null?
proposal.limitations: Significant-only tables: the 96 targeted and 260 control DE counts come from significant-only DEseq2 tables, so no inference of zero expression or absence of biological effects is possible from omitted rows, and no all-measured-genes denominator exists. Reference not personal H1: GRCh38 is a reference assembly, not a personalized H1 genome, so coordinates and distances are reference-based. Control overlap is not causality: 31 shared genes (fraction 0.3229166666666667) and 65 targeted-only genes contextualize the targeted changes but cannot establish that the candidate region caused them or that overlap implies safety. Distance is not safety: the 50000 bp gene-body interval gap and 50001 bp nearest-reference-base TSS distance are proximity measurements only; the tss_distance pass is marginal and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Missing cancer/regulatory evidence: cancer_gene_distance, outside_dhs_buffer and outside_ultraconserved_regions are unavailable, so the aggregate screen is incomplete and no global safe label is assigned. Unmapped DE IDs: GENCODE-mapped DE gene counts and nearest mapped DE gene gap were not computed within the tool budget and are reported as null, not zero. Source count discrepancy: the criteria endpoint lists three qPCR genes (MAGI3, TXNL1, ZNRF4) while the inspect artifact lists two (MAGI3, TXNL1); the qPCR computation reports three, and this is unreconciled. Controls were available (260 independent untargeted DE genes), so controls_unavailable is not asserted. H9 context was not consumed, so cell_context_not_transferable is not asserted. Overall suitability is not established.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Independently challenge numerical claims, denominators, control awareness, applicability to H1, and unsupported biological conclusions. Reconcile contradictions explicitly. Do not turn absent results into failures or label suitability established. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

experimental_endpoint_results.reason: For the publication-derived shortlist candidate Pansio-1 (GRCh38 chr1:113,339,960-113,340,514, zero-based half-open; H1 human embryonic stem cells; data_version autio-79592-v2-gencode36-comp-pseudo-2026-09-26), the measured expression changes do not justify excluding the region under the frozen safe-harbor-criteria-v1. The targeted Pansio-1 H1 contrast contains 96 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes (48 up, 48 down) at |log2FC|>=1 and FDR<=0.01, while the independent untargeted H1 contrast contains 260 DE genes; 31 genes are shared and 65 are targeted-only, giving a shared fraction of 31/96 = 0.3229166666666667. The GENCODE v36 annotation screen passes outside_gene_body (0 overlaps), tss_distance (nearest reference base distance 50,001 bp > 50,000), mirna_distance (878,128 bp > 300,000) and lncrna_distance (266,848 bp > 100,000), but cancer_gene_distance, outside_dhs_buffer and outside_ultraconserved_regions are unavailable, so the aggregate screen is incomplete. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety; the exclusion decision is therefore not justified by available evidence, and the endpoint evidence status remains unknown. This is a publication-derived shortlist, not a newly discovered locus, and GRCh38 is a reference assembly rather than a personalized H1 genome.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 4 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 2 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Publish a concise inspectable synthesis scoped to the named endpoint and assay. Include evidence IDs and remaining limitations. Label publication-derived shortlist, deterministic operational versus real model mode, and provisional unknowns faithfully. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. Use null for missing numerical evidence, never zero. Screen status obeys the frozen required criteria. Expression-control overlap is shared_count/targeted_de_count. Distinguish interval gap from nearest reference base distance. Use evidence_status unknown unless an explicit named experimental endpoint result supports more. Overall suitability is not established. limitation_codes vocabulary: significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control
experimental_endpoints.table_coverage: Significant-only results; no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows.
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Reconciliation must state limitations and unresolved questions.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted and independent untargeted H1 cultures versus reference untargeted H1
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: Numerical replicate values are provided; significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.
